findings.claim: A bad UTF-8 byte in the first data record is reported on line 1 when the decodable prefix ends mid-line and contains no complete data records. The early header-error branch also discards any readable currency and amount, so Monzo can omit a flow limit already reached.
findings.repro: Give cma import monzo a file with line 1 `Transaction ID,Date,Type,Amount,Currency,Name` and line 2 starting `tx_1,01/01/2026,Faster payment,10000000000000.00,GBP,CAF`, followed by raw byte 0xE9 and LF. The prefix parses the header but cut mode does not return the unfinished first data row. The importer reports line 1 without the money-in limit. The refusal must identify line 2 and account for the readable GBP amount.
